design_rationale:
WORKLOG task 0 (workflow task) — documentation_release_desk, category bol, M=2. Revision 2 (rework after policy-task audit revision_1).

[Scope] First task. Claimed: workflow bol_wf_post_issuance_correction_with_originals_back; policies bol_ext_correction_originals_return (step 0), bol_ext_post_departure_correction_fee (step 2), bol_ext_corrected_set_issue (step 3); tools return_originals_for_correction_b9bd03b3 (user), apply_particular_correction_a24e9121, charge_correction_fee_18211c73, issue_corrected_set_a7062696. Task 1 holds the disjoint issuance / telex family (bol_issued, bol_originals_surrender_completed, bol_release_fee_charged).

[Why a good test] Surface goal: notify-party correction on straight bill AHLU2609238451 and the corrected bill issued. Hidden: on AHL Straight Bill of Lading originals_return_required_for_correction is true, so nothing is applied until the originals of the set in force are back (document: set 2, originals_outstanding 3, after an earlier gross-weight correction on 2026-09-03); the lodged count is reconciled over the whole originals history (set 1 issued 3 and returned 2 + 1; set 2 issued 3) and is due only while a correction request on file awaits the customer (four requests on file, three closed: a completed pre-issuance round, a declined cargo_description request of 2026-09-02, the completed gross-weight correction, and the open notify-party request of 2026-09-03 16:10, the only one awaiting); the fee is the after-departure 150.00 because the booking departed 2026-09-02 (not 75.00); the corrected set is set 3 (bl_set_sequence plus 1), issued only after the fee and carrying 3 originals read at handling time.

[Problem-tree card] Root bol_ext_corrected_set_issue. E1 root -> bol_ext_correction_originals_return, value_input, binding all_back; false at opening: bills_of_lading.6c4db966-ec56-4fd4-b92c-45356ddabb6a.originals_outstanding = 3, bl_set_sequence = 2, ledger 2be7f768-8745-434b-a557-106399c5afc2 set 2 issued 3. E2 root -> bol_ext_post_departure_correction_fee, state_gate bol_ledger.request_id; false: the only correction fee row 356dc5df-a6ee-494a-b17e-3738091a02cf carries the gross-weight request e340be16-bbed-4d1a-953a-73f7d9da0bde, not 82eddc3b-79c3-427c-bfd8-78b06b66abb4. E3 fee -> originals_return, state_gate bol_correction.originals_back_first; false: outstanding 3, request awaiting. Order: lodgement (step 7) -> correction (9) -> fee (11) -> corrected set (13). Sensitivity run (scratch verify.py 0, revision 2): 'set <- return value_input with 3 without 0 hash differs True'; 'set <- fee state_gate with 3 without 3 hash differs True'; 'fee <- return state_gate with 150.0 without 150.0 hash differs True'.

[Zero-wait card — audit F0-1 closed] step 0 lodgement: the issued document and its 3 outstanding originals (initial_state_preexisting), the open notify-party request, the only correction request awaiting the customer (initial_state_preexisting), and the originals physically at the line's Felixstowe origin office with the caller, who is standing at the documentation counter during the call for another shipment's paperwork (current_user_input: 'you are standing at the line's Felixstowe documentation counter this morning'); the lodgement is her own act at the counter, not a delivery. step 1: outstanding 0 from step 0 (prior_synchronous_tool_effect). step 2: executed correction from step 1. step 3: outstanding 0 (step 0), fee row (step 2), waiting gate anchor on the request (preexisting). Nothing waits on a delivery, payment clearing, approval or elapsed time. The workflow scenario now states that it applies when the documentation party has the originals with it at the origin office during the contact, and order_rationale says that otherwise the procedure does not start and the request waits within its return deadline (audit O8).

[Base-invariant card] step 7 bol_originals_surrendered: bol_correction, bol_telex_release, bol_cargo_release -> policy_scope (no gate applies to that event). step 9 bol_particulars_corrected: within_departure_window (departed 2026-09-02 + 10 calendar days = 2026-09-12 inclusive; frozen 2026-09-11 inside; 2026-09-13 would fail), originals_back_first (step 7). step 11 bol_correction_fee_charged: within_departure_window, fee_on_issued (status issued), charge_request_once (no fee row carries 82eddc3b-79c3-427c-bfd8-78b06b66abb4). step 13 bol_set_replaced: originals_back_first (step 7) and bol_lost_original_reissue.waiting_period, which base structurally attaches to every bol_set_replaced (audit O10): anchor created_at 2026-09-03 + 7 = 2026-09-10 inclusive, frozen 2026-09-11 satisfied, so it passes under both readings. notify_party_name is correctable after departure on the tier; max_corrections_after_issuance 2 with one completed after issuance; weight tolerance of the earlier correction +1.6 % <= 3 %.

[Business-object card] Target document 6c4db966-ec56-4fd4-b92c-45356ddabb6a, booking bb5a760a-a3e4-47bd-9644-821d19f910c7, request 82eddc3b-79c3-427c-bfd8-78b06b66abb4. Excluded requests: 03cb9170-69c6-47d2-97c1-b92d6b63a0c8 (pre-issuance, never charged), f0105f81-5e26-4e76-ab83-07b0ed812d27 (declined: cargo_description is not correctable after departure on a straight bill), e340be16-bbed-4d1a-953a-73f7d9da0bde (completed and already charged 150.00 by 356dc5df-a6ee-494a-b17e-3738091a02cf). Originals rows: 732eeaba-6a25-45ec-8250-43e41c2ca261 (set 1, 3), 4634f650-4f95-4be9-be7d-926f17929585 (2 returned 2026-09-02), 5d1bde1d-a7a4-4e53-bffc-f2e23441a743 (1 returned 2026-09-03), 2be7f768-8745-434b-a557-106399c5afc2 (set 2, 3). Fees: issuance 0b0129c7-2934-4d6d-b54f-a22b0b853f94 65.00 paid by ac21db3a-105e-4d97-a9a5-08443227e75b (AFC-REM-20974); correction 356dc5df-a6ee-494a-b17e-3738091a02cf 150.00 unpaid -> charges_due 150.00.

[Policies — two-way] bol_ext_correction_originals_return (rewritten in revision 2): whole-history SUMs <- 'the sum of originals_count on every originals-issued entry ... never less than zero'; invariant sentence 'an earlier set is always fully returned or voided before the next set is issued' (true here: set 1 3 issued, 3 returned); requests_on_file/requests_closed/request_awaiting <- 'Originals are lodged only while at least one correction request on the document still awaits the customer, counted as the correction requests on file less those completed, withdrawn or declined' (revision 3, audit O13); shipped <- booking status clause; the booking read is the documentation party's own (audit O1); zero never permits a correction without originals (audit O5). bol_ext_post_departure_correction_fee: chosen_fee <- departure / no-departure sentence; scope excludes the line's keying errors explicitly (audit O6); rounding wording states tier amounts are whole cents (audit O2). bol_ext_corrected_set_issue: all_back/per_set/shipped; the fee-first fact is met without a fee row when no fee is due for a keying error (audit O6); zero branch is not a permission (audit O5). base_policy_refs of both originals policies now equal the workflow step refs (bol_issuance lineage removed, audit O7). overwrite: [] for all three.

[Persona] Harriet Pendleford, brisk BCO manager; volunteers only the goal; phone +442072184913 and code AHL-GB-274106 on request; new notify wording verbatim on request; that the originals of the corrected bill issued on 3 September are in her folder at the Felixstowe counter only when asked about originals; lodges only when handed the step; accepts a fee, pays nothing today; closes when the corrected bill is issued.

[Standard solution] find_customers -> verify(phone, code) -> find_bills_of_lading -> find_bookings -> find_bol_ledger -> find_bol_service_requests -> call(user) return_originals (bl, set 2, 3) -> apply_particular_correction (notify_party_name, verbatim) -> charge_correction_fee 150.00 -> issue_corrected_set (set 3, 3 originals). Terminal: document issued, set 3, outstanding 3, charges_due 300.00, request completed.

[Verification run, revision 2 — re-run in revision 3 with the same values] verify.py 0: 'bol_ext_correction_originals_return 7 3 expected 3'; 'bol_ext_post_departure_correction_fee 11 150.0 expected 150.0'; 'bol_ext_corrected_set_issue 13 3 expected 3'. Gates: EXTENDED OK, TASK TOOL CONTRACT OK, REPLAY OK, SOLVABILITY OK, COMPUTE OK (23 factors, 8 history rows, 10 branches), GROUNDING OK, SCOPE OK.

[Traps] 75.00 instead of 150.00; counting set 2 only as 'issued 3 - 0' is equal here but counting set 1 rows without its returns gives 6; lodging for the declined or completed request; set 2 instead of set 3; issuing the set before the fee.

[Draft recomputation from visible context] straight bill needs originals back -> caller at the Felixstowe counter lodges 3 of set 2 -> correction applied with the request wording -> fee 150.00 -> corrected set 3 with 3 originals. Matches gold.

[Revisions] r1 (round 1): fee compute cut to 5 bindings; helpers moved into class _Doc; seed ledger rows carry null request/reference ids. r2 (round 2, audit): F0-1 — the originals were in the caller's office safe (a physical delivery after the call); the world now places the caller and the originals at the line's Felixstowe origin office during the contact, disclosed only when asked; zero_wait_proof, required_user_inputs, stage_provenance and the workflow scenario/order_rationale were updated (O8). To keep one task with a history of at least 8 rows after task 1 was rebuilt, the world gained the earlier gross-weight correction (set 1 -> set 2) and a declined request, and bol_ext_correction_originals_return now reconciles the whole originals history and whether a correction request awaits; the return is of set 2 and the corrected set is set 3. O1, O2, O5, O6 and O7 edits as listed above.

[Revision 3 (audit revision_2)] F0-2: the two edge_load_bearing sentences still carried round-1 figures; recomputed on this world by the scratch replay (skip the named write, replay the rest): skip the lodgement -> corrected set value 0 instead of 3, document ends set 3 with originals_outstanding 6 instead of 3, charges_due 300.00, hash differs; skip the fee -> originals_count still 3, charges_due ends 150.00 instead of 300.00, hash differs; skip the lodgement for the fee edge -> fee still 150.00, document ends set 3 with outstanding 6, hash differs. The replay printed full terminal {status issued, set 3, outstanding 3, charges_due 300.0}, skip-lodge {set 3, outstanding 6, charges_due 300.0}, skip-fee {set 3, outstanding 3, charges_due 150.0}. O12: bol_ext_correction_originals_return and the return tool now say the printed shipper, who alone can hand in the originals, lodges them; the documentation party's lodgement counts only when its registered company_name matches shipper_name exactly (here 'Ashcombe Fine Ceramics Ltd' on both), else the request waits; the workflow scenario and order_rationale say the same. O13: the 'latest correction request awaits' gate was replaced by 'at least one correction request on file still awaits the customer' (requests on file less completed, withdrawn or declined), which is base's own reading; here 4 on file, 3 closed, 1 awaiting, so the value is unchanged (3) and the history reconciled is still 8 rows (4 originals rows + 4 correction requests). O16: bol_msr_corrections_after_issuance counts the gross-weight correction of 2026-09-02 14:30 as 1 under the original-issue reading and 0 under the issued_date-as-it-stands reading (2026-09-03); both are below max_corrections_after_issuance 2 and free_corrections_after_issuance is 0, so eligibility and the 150.00 fee are the same under both readings; the base measure is frozen and no extended text restates it. Per-task gates re-run after revision 3: EXTENDED OK, TASK TOOL CONTRACT OK, REPLAY OK, SOLVABILITY OK, COMPUTE OK, GROUNDING OK, SCOPE OK.
user_scenario: You are Harriet Pendleford, export documentation manager at Ashcombe Fine Ceramics Ltd, a porcelain maker that ships its own tableware to a US importer. You are brisk, organised and a little exasperated, and you speak in short, practical sentences. On 3 September you put in a request with Aurelia Hanse Line to change the notify party on your straight bill of lading AHLU2609238451, because the importer in New York has switched customs brokers, and you have heard nothing since. You are calling to get that bill corrected today and to have the corrected bill issued, and you are happy for the agent to do whatever the line has to do on its side to get there. You open by giving your name and company and saying you are chasing the notify party correction on bill AHLU2609238451 and need the corrected bill issued. If the agent asks how to find your account you give your phone number, +442072184913, and when asked for a second detail to confirm who you are you give your customer code, AHL-GB-274106. You do not remember your tax number or the date the account was opened and say so if pressed. If the agent asks what the notify party should now read, you read it out exactly as you sent it: Harborline Customs Brokerage LLC, 1 Port Avenue, Newark NJ 07114. The booking number on your confirmation is AHLU26FXT231907 if the agent wants it. You do not know the internal steps of a correction and you never suggest any. Only when the agent asks about the original bills do you say that the three originals of the corrected bill issued on 3 September are in the document folder you have with you, because you are standing at the line's Felixstowe documentation counter this morning, where you came to drop off export paperwork for another shipment, and you rang the desk from there; nobody has presented those originals anywhere. If the agent tells you the originals have to be handed back to the line first and gives you the step to lodge them, you agree, lodge exactly the originals the agent tells you to lodge at the counter, and tell the agent it is done. Once the agent tells you there is a fee for the correction, you accept it without argument; you know changes after sailing cost money and you will pay it with the next invoice run, so you do not want to pay anything today. When the agent confirms the corrected bill has been issued, you thank them and end the call; you have nothing else to raise.

prerequisite_closure.order_uniqueness: P_SET has two out-edges (to the lodgement and to the fee), but the fee itself depends on the lodgement, so the only topological order is lodgement, fee, corrected set; the workflow fixes the same order and the correction application sits between lodgement and fee by the originals_back_first gate. No free reordering remains, so no second terminal state exists.

edge_load_bearing.skipped_effect: Skipping the lodgement at step 7 and replaying the rest on this world: bol_ext_corrected_set_issue recomputes originals_count 0 instead of 3 at step 13 (originals_outstanding stays 3, all_back false); with the rest of the gold writes replayed the document ends as set 3 with originals_outstanding 6 instead of 3, charges_due_usd 300.00, and no surrendered entry; the terminal hash differs.

Skipping the fee at step 11: the corrected set's originals_count is still 3, but the terminal state loses the bol_correction_fee_charged row of 150.00 for the notify-party request, so charges_due_usd ends 150.00 (the opening balance of the earlier gross-weight fee) instead of 300.00, and the request_id handed to step 13 has no fee row behind it; the terminal hash differs.

Skipping the lodgement: the fee still recomputes 150.00 (its value does not read originals), but the terminal state lacks the surrendered entry and the document ends as set 3 with originals_outstanding 6 instead of 3, a state the originals_back_first gate forbids; the terminal hash differs.

prerequisite_closure.no_user_hint: The persona asks only for the notify party correction and the corrected bill. It never mentions lodging or returning originals or a fee being booked first; her presence at the Felixstowe counter and the originals in her folder are disclosed only when the agent asks about the original bills, and she was there for another shipment's paperwork; she lodges only after the agent explains it and hands over the step.
